pumping_after.instructions: Literal evidence extraction only: does a cited time-resolved record explicitly place hydraulic-fracturing pumping AFTER the event timestamp? An operation date window, aggregate volume/hours, production, and absence of logs mean no. Ignore whether any rule applies.

restart_documented.instructions: Literal evidence extraction only: does a cited time-resolved record explicitly document a STOP followed by a RESTART of hydraulic-fracturing pumping after the earthquake? Continuous pumping without a stop is not a restart. Missing records mean no.

written_consent_documented.instructions: Literal evidence extraction only: does the packet supply a written AER consent record authorizing THIS well and resumed operation BEFORE its restart? A public search with no match means no supplied document, never proof that permission did not exist. No restart described means no.
